purpose: Describe acting without regard for a circumstance.
keywords: N / plain clauseの + もかまわず
He spoke loudly without caring about the disturbance to others.
She entered the river to help the child, heedless of getting her clothes wet.
Construction continued regardless of it being the middle of the night.
formation: N / plain clauseの + もかまわず
restrictions: The ignored factor would normally merit consideration.
mistake: It often implies disregard, rather than considerate indifference.
